raw_text:
That can be really tough to navigate. It might be helpful to talk to someone who has gone through a similar situation, like a trusted friend or family member, or even a therapist. They can offer you support and guidance on how to process your emotions and figure out what to do next.

In the meantime, I can suggest a few things. Have you considered talking to someone who has experienced a similar breakup? Maybe they can offer some advice or just listen to you vent.
